content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing.

- Regarding the clause "All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.", this means your intellectual property rights transfer to the Client upon delivery rather than upon full payment, which means you could lose ownership rights if payment is delayed or withheld. I suggest modifying this so that: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon full payment of all applicable fees.
- Regarding the clause "Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.", the Client can terminate the contract immediately without notice and without paying for completed work, leaving you uncompensated for your time and efforts. I suggest modifying this so that: Client may terminate this Agreement upon 30 days prior written notice and shall pay Contractor pro rata for all Services performed and Deliverables created up to the effective date of termination.

Looking forward to getting started.

Best regards
